sentences.text: Shri Rajendra Yadav - Advocate for the applicant.
Ms. Papiya Ghosh - Panel Laywer for the State.

Order 
This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.93/2024 dated 29.2.2024 registered at Police Station Nowrozabad, District Umaria for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 366-A, 368, 376(2)(n), 376 (D), and 109 of IPC and Section 5L/6 Of POCSO Act.
2. Counsel for the applicant contends that the applicant is mother of co-accused Lallan Baiga and the prosecutrix was in relationship with Lallan Baiga.
Later on the statement of victim as well as her parents have been recorded by the trial Court.
In their statement they have turned hostile and have not supported the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:60493 2 MCRC-51343-2024 allegations levelled by the prosecution.

It is thus contended that in view of the statement of the parents as well as victim, the applicant who is lady and is suffering incarceration since 31.7.2024,
deserves to be enlarged on bail.

3. The counsel for the State submits that notice to victim has been served: however, counsel for the State has opposed the prayer and submitted that the offence was committed against the minor girl,
therefore, no case for grant of bail is made out.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.
5. A perusal of record reflects that the prosecutrix was in relationship with the son of the applicant.
Prosecutrix as well as her parents have turned hostile before the trial Court and have not supported the case of the prosecution.

The applicant is a lady and is in custody since 31.7.2024.
6.
Thus, taking into consideration the totality of the circumstances of the case, this Court is of the considered view that it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:60493 3 MCRC-51343-2024 satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for her appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.

8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480 (3) of the BNSS.
9.
Accordingly, M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.
